get.description: Discover visible model identities, declared input/output capabilities, installation policy, recipe operations, terms and Director compatibility. Audio output flags include standalone speech/music. These independent states are not a promise of current runtime or GPU readiness; model-specific settings remain discoverable through model-options and defaults.

model_type.description: Stable model ID for model-options, defaults, downloads and generation.

architecture.description: Runtime architecture ID; not proof of installed or ready execution.

anyOf.description: Descriptive model metadata; not a runtime readiness verdict.

supports_audio.description: Legacy combined audio flag: accepts audio conditioning or generates audio.

supports_audio_input.description: The handler accepts audio conditioning. Inspect model-options for accepted forms.

generates_audio.description: The handler produces audio, including audio-only speech/music or audiovisual output. Does not imply native qualification.

audio_only.description: The handler produces standalone audio instead of video/image output.

is_i2v.description: The runtime class exposes image-to-video support.

is_t2v.description: The runtime class exposes text-to-video support.

supports_ref_images.description: Reference image choices are declared; inspect model-options.

is_downloaded.description: Catalog installation check finds required assets. Not a model load or execution readiness result.

downloadable.description: Curated download policy permits this model. Project authorization and current terms still apply.

manual_installation_ready.description: A manual installation contract is declared; not proof that its checkpoint is installed.

availability_status.description: Current legal/install policy state, e.g. available, manual_installation_required, or location_declaration_required. Extensible; not a GPU/runtime readiness result.

manual_checkpoint_verification_required.description: A manual checkpoint needs the existing local verification workflow.

manual_checkpoint_verified.description: Current manual integrity check passed where required; false is also used when no check applies.

supported_operations.description: Operations explicitly declared by the capability recipe. An empty list does not disable generic generation; inspect model-options/defaults and the execution guards.

default_for_operations.description: Operations for which this recipe declares itself a default.

automatic_routing.description: Recipe explicitly permits automatic routing; not permission to submit work.

verified.description: Recipe declares verification. Installation and capability-specific qualification remain separate.

retake_engines.description: Declared compatible Retake engines; empty means none.

h3_gallery_av_guides.description: H3 Gallery audiovisual guide experiment is enabled for this model on this host.

h3_face_refine.description: Optional H3 face refinement capability; only returned when available.

fps.description: Model-declared default frames per second; not encoded output metadata.

director.description: Per-Director-mode compatibility, explanations, audio input/output and reference strategies. Read each mode; audio generation alone does not imply Director video compatibility.

required_host_terms.description: Current required source/model terms. Read project-scoped host-terms for acceptance; human acceptance remains required.

update_status.description: Current updater state or pinned/versioned recipe status; not execution readiness.

nsfw_only.description: Retained upstream descriptive metadata; does not gate local content execution.

manual_installation.description: Optional confined manual checkpoint manifest with public source, filename, byte/hash pins and local verification guidance.

pipeline_type.description: Choose music/audio-driven planning or a story-driven short film. The story workflow is short_film_story; short_film is not a pipeline type.

scene_description.description: Scene or story text. A nonempty scene_description takes precedence over story_description.

story_description.description: Story text alias for short_film_story and short_film_audio when scene_description is absent or empty. The exact text reaches both planning backends and saved/queue descriptions; frozen submitted fields are not rewritten.

hold_planning.description: Save the genuine parent without starting planning or loading models. Continue before_planning with an empty body to release the frozen request.

hold_video.description: Keep generated video children held after planning/image review; release the exact authorized child through Studio Queue. This does not hold LLM planning.

prepared_clip_plans.description: Explicit authored clip prompts. A nonempty list skips LLM planning and prompt polishing, while retaining normal model, reference, project and execution admission. Supply matching prepared_planned_clips for exact shot durations. Cannot be combined with hold_planning.

prepared_planned_clips.description: Timing records aligned with prepared_clip_plans; use start/end or duration_sec in seconds. They do not bypass native frame alignment or model duration limits.

image_model.description: Legacy combined image selection; do not mix with creator/editor role model fields.

h3_style_workflow.description: Exact server-catalog workflow ID only; no caller workflow metadata.

auto_mode.description: False pauses after planning for prompt review and after image generation for image review. True proceeds automatically. Planning and video holds remain separate.

shot_image_guidance.description: Request per-shot image behavior. Models requiring start images still generate them; direct-reference models retain direct references. Optional-image models can use prompt_only. Auto uses their references when present. The effective policy is frozen at admission.

director_max_shot_frames.description: Optional expert H3 segment ceiling, aligned and clamped to the selected model's native frame lattice. Omit for automatic planning. It does not override resource limits or a model's minimum frames.

seamless.description: Request continuity across video shots. Compatibility is model-specific; it may require native endpoint conditioning. False keeps independent shots.

get.description: Read the retained pipeline by the ID returned from start. The response field is id; progress is an object. Stop acknowledgements do not prove worker or model resources have drained. Interrupted planning tied to a private execution reservation remains blocked_planning_admission after restart until its owning recovery path supplies fresh authority; Continue cannot bypass that state. get.description: Read the initialized production rerun builder and sealed input dependency without creating a job, repair intent, model load or output. Supports clip zero of one ordinary H3 short_film_story: a cancelled retained editor-image pipeline, or a failed supervised LoRA original at its exhausted retry limit with released custody and unchanged sealed lineage. Experimental Ref2VA preparation supports one cancelled story clip using current owner/project-bound retained style images only, without a starting image, ordinary references, audio source, long-form plan or active LoRAs; exact retained image bytes are revalidated. Other shapes return an unsupported/state error; this does not establish complete rerun parity. The subsequent POST creates a distinct child and never resets the exhausted original. Hashes observe current inputs; they are not authority, reservations or mutation replay tokens. Actual execution still needs normal project/session/model/terms/resource checks and fresh GPU authority.

post.summary: Reconcile an already terminal saved clip video attempt
post.description: Checkpoint only the exact existing ordinary saved-video repair after its child is durably completed, failed or cancelled. Never submits, registers, resumes or cancels generation. Read recovery.video_repairs from the saved pipeline to obtain job_id and revision. A nonterminal or blocked child returns409; an observation timeout or drained process alone never authorizes a terminal disposition. An owner may separately cancel the exact unwanted child through the existing cancellation operation. Repeating this reconciliation for the same terminal identity is idempotent, including after supported queue-row compaction; mismatched identities, revisions or retained proofs conflict. Current project/session/origin authorization applies; model availability, new terms acceptance and GPU authority are not required because no model work occurs.

Runtime, project, model terms, media and native admission remain authoritative.

video_length.description: For H3 cumulative mode, total requested published frames at native 24 fps, minimum 22. Resource, checkpoint and window limits can reject longer chains. Terminal native-grid padding is trimmed from publication. Other models retain their own units and limits.

multi_prompts_gen_type.description: For H3 cumulative mode, use 2 to retain one authored timeline prompt, including line breaks. Per-clip prompt/frame arrays are incompatible. Other models retain their existing prompt modes.

sliding_window_size.description: For H3 cumulative mode, first-window ceiling: 22 + 17*n frames, n=0..19 (22 through 345), default 345 when unset. The first window is floored to the native grid within total video_length. Later windows use 22 context frames. Other models retain their discovered sliding-window contract.

h3_cumulative_append.description: Experimental Base H3 retained-audio/video continuation. Discover model-options/minimax_h3.h3_cumulative_append first; false means the host operator has disabled admission. Requires minimax_h3 video, image_mode 0, batch_size 1, one timeline prompt and no enhancement, reference/source media, LoRAs, step cache, Turbo/Spectrum/LightX2V, decoded boundary conditioning or postprocessing. video_length is the total published frames at 24 fps; sliding_window_size is the first-window ceiling. Later windows reuse normalized native AV state. This differs from Gallery Extend with video_source and from Director shot plans. Inspect returned h3_cumulative_plan. Interrupted cumulative jobs can remain held for owner recovery; existing longform final-segment recovery does not cover them. A saved checkpoint is not permission to replay or resubmit. See the API guide.

settings_version.description: When omitted, a new HTTP admission uses the current settings version returned by /api/v1/defaults/{model_type}. Retain an explicitly saved old version only when importing its legacy settings; it enables historical migrations, including audio processing flags. Existing admitted jobs and repeated submission identities are unchanged.

get.description: Session-owned physical job projection with lifecycle, progress, output filenames, resource, queue and recovery fields. H3 prompt text is blanked in polling. Recovery-blocked jobs have null queue position/ETA and expose estimate_after_resume. Resources may still be releasing after terminal cancellation. Private no-store response. completion_policy and completion_cleanup report invocation-scoped generation-model cleanup; terminal generation status alone does not prove release. Configure before admission through PUT /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/completion-policy. A queued supervised hold exposes recovery_requires_gpu_reservation=true and recovery_blocked=true; renew exact operator authority and release the original job rather than resubmitting. These flags are not GPU authority.

post.description: Uses only the server-advertised recovery action. Revalidates the sealed request, original owner/project, inputs and attempt limit. For a never-started, queued and held Studio generation blocked by resource admission, retry preserves the original request/job identity and registers the same job while held; it returns restored, held=true and reruns_denoise=false without starting a worker or loading a model. Release it separately only after execution prerequisites, model terms and GPU authority are satisfied. Other eligible failed/blocked work creates a fresh worker attempt after model/terms admission. Resume is for reauthentication/legal-access holds. H3 may require an authorized calibrated replacement plan; ordinary H3 retry can restart the whole clip. Delivery children and paired sample arms use dedicated routes. With publication_only=true, an eligible failed saved Director ordinary H3 single-task/single-repeat MP4 can recover its exact authenticated consumed native bytes from private quarantine. This separate CPU attempt runs existing empty-step Director delivery integrity/publication, never loads a model and never redraws. It does not support requested effects, mapping, longform, scene groups or saved-style observation. Original native receipts and quarantine are preserved. After completion reconcile the same saved repair job/revision through rerun-video/reconcile. An interrupted, held CPU publication resumes only after the same explicit publication_only=true request revalidates its sealed intent; this retains its current CPU attempt and cannot enter native generation.

Drama3CustomSettings.description: Drama 3 optional settings. References use authorized uploads and require actual transcripts. The GPU budget covers weights and worst-case expert staging; caches and CUDA overhead are additional.

drama3_expert_cache_gib.description: GPU LRU of original FP8 experts. This value plus drama3_gpu_budget_gib must be at most26GiB; activations, codec and CUDA overhead need additional headroom.

drama3_separate_turns.description: 1 preserves each explicitly tagged speaker turn as a separate generation chunk, including repeated speakers, with native audio history. Experimental mitigation for skipped turns; not a word-completeness guarantee. 0 retains Fish's native batching.

drama3_prefix_cache.description: Experimental one-entry CPU prefix cache, at most96MiB per loaded model. Reuses the first128native rows only when the first129complete rows and current model/cache/math bindings match. Memory-only; model-setting changes or unload discard it. Separate from disk reference codes.

drama3_tower_graph.description: Experimental instance-owned tower-only CUDA graphs. Requires drama3_prefix_cache=1, drama3_restricted_speech_head=1 and scalar temperature0.8/top_k30/top_p0.8 on the supported BF16 tower. Captures bounded256/384-row buckets on first eligible use; setup is cold cost. Other settings, longer positions or changed cache bindings use original eager decode. Does not enable these prerequisites or alter sampling/codebooks. Finite and uncertain CUDA capture failures abort rather than retry.

drama3_reference_cache.description: 1 automatically reuses content-bound prepared reference codes in bounded CPU memory and private disk storage. Explicit 0 opts out for this generation. This does not cache model weights or establish GPU readiness.

drama3_restricted_speech_head.description: Experimental original-BF16 EOS/semantic-only output projection. Smaller GEMM geometry can change rounding. No sampler or codebook reduction.

drama3_bulk_expert_pack.description: Experimental byte-exact batched FP8 expert-cache packing; requires a nonzero expert cache. Does not alter quantization or sampler.

drama3_compile_recurrence.description: Experimental per-model compilation of single-token FP32 recurrence, without CUDA graphs. First use compiles; fused arithmetic can alter speech delivery. No sampler or precision reduction.

drama3_gpu_codec.description: Experimental FP32 GPU waveform decoding, restoring codec to CPU each chunk. Original CPU fallback for chunks above256 frames or insufficient VRAM; reserves3GiB plus codec tensors.

drama3_gpu_codec_bf16.description: Requires drama3_gpu_codec=1. Decode with a private BF16 codec copy; original CPU reference encoder stays FP32. Changes waveform arithmetic.

drama3_reference_text.description: Actual transcript of audio_guide for zero-based Speaker 0; required when that reference is present, at most 16000 UTF-8 bytes.

drama3_reference_text2.description: Actual transcript of audio_guide2 for zero-based Speaker 1; required when that reference is present, at most 16000 UTF-8 bytes.

drama3_reference_text3.description: Actual transcript of audio_guide3 for zero-based Speaker 2; required when that reference is present, at most 16000 UTF-8 bytes.

Drama3GenerationSettings.description: Model-specific projection of the existing /api/v1/generate request. Start from discovered defaults. Experimental local NVIDIA FP8/CPU expert offload; no cross-request history, Q6 or LoRA support. Duration caps output and can truncate speech. Terms and GPU authority remain required.

prompt.description: Speech with inline [delivery] cues and <|speaker:0|> through <|speaker:15|>, or Maestro Speaker 1: through Speaker 16: lines.

alt_prompt.description: Performance cue applied to every speaker in this job; adherence depends on the model.

audio_guide.description: Project-authorized upload filename; maximum 60 seconds, with its corresponding transcript. Never an arbitrary filesystem path.

audio_guide2.description: Project-authorized upload filename; maximum 60 seconds, with its corresponding transcript. Never an arbitrary filesystem path.

audio_guide3.description: Project-authorized upload filename; maximum 60 seconds, with its corresponding transcript. Never an arbitrary filesystem path.

VoxCPM2GenerationSettings.description: Projection of the existing generation operation; discover current model-options/defaults. VoxCPM ignores temperature, top_p, top_k, seed and duration_seconds; token limit bounds speech.

num_inference_steps.description: Iterative decoder steps, 1–100; legacy 0 uses 30. More steps cost time and do not guarantee better quality.

audio_guide.description: Project-authorized uploaded voice reference filename. Required for IndexTTS2.

voxcpm_retry_badcase.description: 0 disables native automatic bad-case retries; 1 enables them.

IndexTTS2GenerationSettings.description: Projection of the existing generation operation; discover current model-options/defaults. IndexTTS2 uses these steps in its diffusion decoder; GPT sampler settings remain separate.

num_inference_steps.description: Iterative decoder steps, 1–100; legacy 0 uses 25. More steps cost time and do not guarantee better quality.

audio_guide.description: Project-authorized uploaded voice reference filename. Required for IndexTTS2.

KugelAudioGenerationSettings.description: Projection of the existing generation operation; discover current model-options/defaults. KugelAudio uses these steps in its native diffusion head; alt_prompt is not a voice-direction input.

num_inference_steps.description: Iterative decoder steps, 1–100; legacy 0 uses 20. More steps cost time and do not guarantee better quality.

audio_guide.description: Project-authorized uploaded voice reference filename. Required for IndexTTS2.

ChatterboxGenerationSettings.description: Projection of the existing generation operation; discover current model-options/defaults. Chatterbox uses these steps in its acoustic flow-matching decoder; autoregressive sampler settings remain separate.

num_inference_steps.description: Iterative decoder steps, 1–100; legacy 0 uses 10. More steps cost time and do not guarantee better quality.

audio_guide.description: Project-authorized uploaded voice reference filename. Required for IndexTTS2.

alt_prompt.description: Unused by Chatterbox; use custom_settings.exaggeration and pace.

pace.description: Classifier-free guidance weight, exposed as Pace.

DirectorVideoLoras.description: Director's public video LoRA selection. Read /api/v1/loras/{video_model}/details first. Parameter filenames must also be active; copy the current schema digest and obey its types, required values and defaults. Generation scope with empty roles is required. Admission freezes the selection; continue cannot replace it. Native qualification depends on the model and scheduler, independently of schema availability.

activated_loras.description: Exact filenames from this video model's active LoRA catalog.

loras_multipliers.description: Complete native strength schedule in catalog order; empty uses native defaults. Spaces separate adapters, commas schedule steps and semicolons separate supported phases. The consuming model validates its supported phases.

lora_parameters.description: At most 65536 UTF-8 bytes after canonical serialization. Keys are active catalog basenames, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, without slash, backslash or NUL; '.' and '..' are invalid. A server-known parameter contract must be supplied even when using its defaults.

parameter_schema_digest.description: Exact schema_digest returned by LoRA details, never a client-generated hash.

parameter_values.description: IDs match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}; values must match the discovered schema. Strings are bounded to 500 UTF-8 bytes. Integers must be safe JavaScript integers; non-integer numbers must be finite with absolute value at most 1e12. No null or nested values.

DirectorRenderSettings.description: Director render settings. Discover /api/v1/defaults/{model_type} and /api/v1/model-options/{model_type}; model locks, native canvas and frame constraints still apply. Extra saved fields remain compatible but do not imply native forwarding: current video builders use steps, guidance and resolution, set seed to -1, and do not forward arbitrary flow_shift or custom_settings. H3 may use extra profile settings for shot planning.

resolution.description: Exact native canvas from model discovery; must agree with the selected Director preset/aspect and resolved video or image resolution.

num_inference_steps.description: Requested native steps; respect model/accelerator locks. Director's generic fallback is 8, not the model's recommended default.

guidance_scale.description: Native guidance strength; discover model locks and supported phases. Director's generic fallback is 1.
